metadata.title: Sharp lower bound of the first eigenvalue of the $p$-Laplacian under integral Ricci curvature
metadata.abstract: We prove a sharp Zhong-Yang type lower bound for the first nonzero eigenvalue of the $p$-Laplacian on closed manifolds with small integral Ricci curvature for $p \geq 2$. The proof combines a global elliptic estimate obtained by Sobolev truncation with strict perturbations of one-dimensional comparison profiles.
